abstract: Methotrexate (MTX) was entrapped into liposomes, to which rabbit antibody fragments (Fab') against human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) had been coupled covalently, using N-[4-(p-maleimidophenyl) butyryl] phosphatidyl ethanolamine. By this system, The resulting molar ratio in the prepared liposomes was 15 MTX per Fab', and the activities of both MTX and the antibody were well preserved. The inhibitory effects of MTX entrapped in liposomes bearing anti-hCG Fab' (Lip[MTX, anti-hCG]) on the growth of choriocarcinoma cells (BeWo) in vitro were examined. The 50% inhibitory concentration of Lip[MTX, anti-hCG] was found to be 1 X 10(-3) micrograms MTX/ml, which was significantly lower than the concentrations of control groups, free MTX (2.5 X 10(-3) micrograms/ml) or MTX entrapped in liposomes bearing no antibody (Lip [MTX], 1.3 X 10(-2) micrograms/ml). The effect of the coupling of the specific antibody was more clearly demonstrated by a short-time incubation (60 min) experiment. Lip [MTX, anti-hCG] exhibited marked inhibition on cell growth, compared to MTX entrapped in liposomes bearing non-immunized Fab' (Lip[MTX, non-immunized Fab']). On the other hand, free MTX showed no effect in this experiment. We may conclude that Lip [MTX, anti-hCG] has a specific inhibitory effect on the growth of choriocarcinoma cells in vitro, which suggests the possibility of a specific immunochemotherapy for this disease, using the specific antibody to this tumor coupled to liposomes.
abstract_ja: メトトレキサート(MTX)を、N-[4-(p-マレイミドフェニル)ブチリル]ホスファチジルエタノールアミンを用いて、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)に対するウサギ抗体断片(Fab')を共有結合させたリポソームに封入した。この系により、調製されたリポソームのMTXとFab'のモル比は、Fab'1分子あたりMTX 15分子となり、MTXと抗体の両方の活性は良好に保たれた。hCG結合リポソーム封入MTX(Lip[MTX, anti-hCG])の絨毛癌細胞(BeWo)増殖に対するin vitro阻害効果を検討した。Lip[MTX, anti-hCG]の50%阻害濃度は1×10^-3 μg MTX/mlであり、対照群である遊離MTX(2.5×10^-3 μg/ml)や、抗体を結合していないリポソーム封入MTX(Lip[MTX]、1.3×10^-2 μg/ml)よりも有意に低かった。抗体結合の特異的効果は、短時間(60分)の曝露実験でより明確に示された。Lip[MTX, anti-hCG]は、非免疫化Fab'を結合したリポソーム封入MTX(Lip[MTX, non-immunized Fab'])と比較して、細胞増殖を顕著に阻害した。一方、遊離MTXはこの実験で効果を示さなかった。Lip[MTX, anti-hCG]は培養絨毛癌細胞の増殖に対して特異的な阻害効果を有すると結論され、この腫瘍に対する特異的抗体をリポソームに結合させる特異的免疫化学療法の可能性が示唆された。
